evidence: Labeled 'Fuzzing' and modifies fuzz harnesses (`process_message.cpp`, `process_messages.cpp`) and test utilities (`validation.cpp`).
rationale: Extends fuzz coverage to previously unexercised BIP 157 compact block filter P2P message handlers, directly addressing high-risk message-processing paths. The expanded harness immediately identified an unsigned integer overflow under UBSan in net_processing.
